notes: No amp+cab block — running into tube amp. Confirmed rig: Jonny Greenwood used a Vox AC30TB (Essex A30 — removed per amp+cab policy) with Boss OD-3 (Stupor OD approximation) and Boss RE-20 Space Echo (Cosmos Echo). Mid-forward, slightly psychedelic tone with tribal, percussive character. 4-stage phaser adds swirling quality. Two snapshots: verse riff and heavy chorus.

overdrive.notes: Approximates Boss OD-3 — mid-forward overdrive. ACTIVE in both snapshots. Chorus snapshot pushes Drive harder for more intensity.

modulation.notes: Slow, subtle phaser adds the swirling, slightly psychedelic quality underneath the rhythm guitar. Keep understated — should feel like movement rather than an obvious effect. ACTIVE in both snapshots.

eq.notes: This song lives in the mids. Low cut at 100Hz removes bass muddiness. Mid boost at 500Hz adds the thick low-mid body. Chorus snapshot gets more aggressive mid boost and tighter high cut.

delay.notes: Confirmed Jonny Greenwood used RE-201 Space Echo from 1995. Tempo-synced to 92 BPM. Eighth note (326ms) — 6ms off target, synced value preferred. Short, dark delay at low level adds depth without cluttering rhythm. Treble rolled off to keep repeats dark.

reverb.notes: Room 1-style character — contained, immediate reverb not a large hall. Short decay keeps the percussive attack from getting washy.

1_verse.description: Verse riff tone. Stupor OD at Drive 5.0. Script Mod Phase slow and subtle. Mid boost +4dB at 500Hz. Cosmos Echo at 28% mix. Moderate reverb.

2_chorus.description: Heavy chorus tone. Stupor OD pushed to Drive 6.5. More aggressive mid boost +5dB. Tighter high cut. Delay pulls back to 18% mix so it doesn't clutter the heavier texture. Shorter, drier reverb keeps punch.

playing_notes.pickup_notes: Bridge pickup throughout — maximum attack and definition
playing_notes.technique: Very deliberate and percussive strumming. Let the compressor and OD do the work, don't over-pick.
playing_notes.snapshot_cues: Snapshot 1 for verses. Snapshot 2 for chorus sections where the arrangement thickens.
